purpose: Analytic real-3D normal-contact verification and identical-algorithm preassembly-elimination timing ablation
rules: Both modes use the same active-set/Cholesky algorithm, geometry, material, timestep guard, contact phase and stabilization
Every analytic gate and every repetition must pass before any performance ratio is claimed
Every dynamic body must have velocity U after the first sampled impact frame and position x0+Ut throughout the horizon
No gravity, friction, restitution, rolling or position projection is present; this is an exactly solvable normal-only benchmark
Initial overlap at most a few times 1e-10m is declared to stabilize floating-point touching-contact discovery; it must remain below 1e-8m
Removing exactly fixed-zero tangent variables before versus after mobility assembly is an exact representation change
Matrix bytes measure only the scalar mobility payload, not process RSS or all solver work buffers
Timings include native guard, solver and diagnostics, exclude startup/serialization; one warmup and three retained repetitions
This evidence does not qualify any of the failed frictional trajectories or constitute experimental material validation
